# Travel Cancellation Policy

## Overview

Cancellation fees depend on how far in advance the customer cancels relative to the departure or check-in date. Refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5–10 business days.

---

## Flight Cancellation

| Cancellation Window | Fee |
|---|---|
| 7+ days before departure | No fee |
| 3–6 days before departure | 25% of ticket price |
| 1–2 days before departure | 50% of ticket price |
| Less than 24 hours / no-show | 100% of ticket price (no refund) |

---

## Hotel Cancellation

| Cancellation Window | Fee |
|---|---|
| 7+ days before check-in | No fee |
| 3–6 days before check-in | 1-night penalty |
| 1–2 days before check-in | 50% of total stay |
| Less than 24 hours / no-show | 100% of total stay (no refund) |

---

## Car Rental Cancellation

| Cancellation Window | Fee |
|---|---|
| 7+ days before pick-up | No fee |
| 3–6 days before pick-up | 25% of total rental cost |
| 1–2 days before pick-up | 50% of total rental cost |
| Less than 24 hours / no-show | 100% of total rental cost (no refund) |

---

## Refund Processing

- Refunds are returned to the **original payment method**.
- Processing time: **5–10 business days**.
